modules.title: 三份笔记怎样变成一张汇总表？
脚本怎样把文件整理成汇总表

items.title: 指定要读的文件
items.text: 脚本找到三个 .md 文件，并逐个读出里面的文字。

items.title: 按同一规则整理
items.text: 例如每份笔记取第一行当标题，再排成一行汇总记录。

items.title: 把结果写回磁盘
items.text: 最后生成 summary.csv；这个文件会出现在运行脚本的电脑或服务器上。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 运行前先确认脚本读哪些路径、会不会覆盖已有文件；网页按钮本身不能直接替你运行本机脚本。

lessonPractice.title: 要用 Python 把 200 份 Markdown 汇总成 CSV，原文件不能被覆盖。运行脚本前最重要的准备是什么？

options.label: 确认输入目录、输出文件和覆盖规则，先用少量副本试运行
options.feedback: 文件自动化的主要风险是作用范围和写入结果，先明确并试运行可以避免批量损坏。

options.label: 直接对 200 份正式文件运行，若结果不对再从编辑器撤销
options.feedback: 批量脚本可能跨文件写入，编辑器撤销不一定覆盖整个过程；应先用副本验证范围和输出。

options.label: 只确认脚本能够启动，不检查输出列、编码和异常文件的处理方式
options.feedback: 能够启动只说明语法和环境基本可用，不能证明批量输入、输出和异常路径安全。

en.title: A Python script will summarize 200 Markdown files into CSV without overwriting sources. What preparation matters most before running?

options.label: Confirm input directory, output file, and overwrite rules, then test with a small copied sample
options.feedback: File automation risk comes from scope and writes, so explicit targets and a trial prevent batch damage.

options.label: Run it directly on all 200 production files and use editor Undo if the result is wrong
options.feedback: Batch scripts may write across files, and editor Undo may not cover the process; test scope and output on copies first.

options.label: Check only that the script starts, without verifying output columns, encoding, or malformed files
options.feedback: Starting proves only that syntax and runtime basically work, not that batch input, output, and error paths are safe.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先列出 Python 脚本将读取和写入的准确路径，默认不覆盖任何 Markdown。先复制 3 份文件试运行，展示将生成的 CSV 和错误报告；我确认后再处理完整目录。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: List the exact paths the Python script will read and write and overwrite no Markdown by default. Trial it on three copied files, show the resulting CSV and error report, and wait for confirmation before processing the full directory.

learning.assumes: You know a folder can contain several files.
learning.outcome: You can identify where a Python script runs and which files it will read and write.

modules.title: Turn three notes into one summary file
How a script organizes several files

items.title: Choose the files
items.text: The script finds the `.md` files and reads their text.

items.title: Apply one rule
items.text: For example, it can use the first line of each note as a title.

items.title: Write the result
items.text: It creates `summary.csv` on the machine or server that ran it.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Before running a script, check its paths and whether it can overwrite files. A page button cannot directly run a script on your own computer.
